question: Prof. Hermann Kulke, who passed away, was a Padma Shri awardee celebrated for his research on the history and culture of ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Distinguished German Indologist Prof. Hermann Kulke passed away at the age of 87 on March 10, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Expertise:** He was a pioneering historian of **pre-colonial South Asia**, specializing in early state formation and kingship.
 
• **Odisha Research:** He was a core member of the **Orissa Research Project** and is world-renowned for his work on the **Jagannath cult** and Gajapati kingship.
 
• **Padma Shri (2010):** He was conferred with India's fourth-highest civilian award for his contributions to **Indology**.
 
• **International Honors:** He received the **Order of Merit** from Germany in 2011 and the **Gold Medal** from The Asiatic Society in 2005.
 
• **Academic Legacy:** He served as Professor Emeritus at **Kiel University**, Germany.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Indology__

 __
 
• The academic study of the history, languages, cultures, and philosophies of the Indian subcontinent.
 
 
 
• The Jagannath Cult__
 
 
• A significant religious and cultural tradition centered around Lord Jagannath in Puri, which Prof. Kulke studied extensively to understand political legitimacy in medieval Odisha.
